Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Dawson Creek Environmental Demonstration Areas
105 Those portions of M.U. 7-20 and M.U. 7-33 in the Province of British Columbia contained within the following described boundaries: (a)Sections 30 and 31, Township 78, Range 14, West of the 6th Meridian, Peace River Land District; between 0930 hours and 1530 hours daily; (b)Sections 2, 11, 12, 13 and that part of Sections 14 and 24 lying south of Radar Lake Road, Township 77, Range 16, west of the 6th Meridian, Peace River Land District. [en. B.C. Reg. 176/89, s. 6; am. B.C. Reg. 175/2010, App. 1, s. 4.]
